findings.rule: Avoid zero-radius/sharp internal corners; provide a tool-accessible radius or relief.
findings.reasoning: D7 specifies R0 at an internal step (F7), which cannot be produced as a true sharp internal corner by standard cutting tools. The drawing also includes a general radii note of 0.5 R (S1), making the explicit zero radius unnecessary and difficult to manufacture.
findings.correction: Replace R0 with a manufacturable radius such as R0.5 or larger, or add an undercut/relief groove if a sharp internal corner is functionally required.
